SCALE.$description: SCALE is the base-scale of all size-related tokens (size, space, dimension). The default is 16(px), so it relates to 1rem = 16(px) for font-sizes. If you change it, it will change all size-related tokens.

REM.$description: REM is the base-size of all font-sizes. The default is 16(px), so it relates to 1rem = 16(px). If you change it, it will change all font-related tokens.
